issues.title: Sn modification dilution conflict
issues.source_issue: SnCl2/ethanol stock is described, while the dilution parenthesis names aqueous TiCl4 and water.
issues.task_treatment: Mock-only unresolved-source card; never pick a real recipe or silently fix the text.

issues.title: Model crystal formula conflict
issues.source_issue: Preparation heading uses [Bcmim]2Pb3Cl2I6·2DMF; characterization, main discussion and SI use [Bcmim]4Pb3Cl2I6·2DMF.
issues.task_treatment: Use reaction-parent lineage plus neutral crystal-family ID; preserve both labels without choosing a formula.

issues.title: Device illumination unit conflict
issues.source_issue: Device Methods report 100 mA cm^-2 as light intensity, whereas ageing reports 100 mW cm^-2.
issues.task_treatment: Keep device value as reported and mark irradiance unresolved; PCE requires separately valid mock irradiance card.

issues.title: This-work stack conflict
issues.source_issue: SI Table S1 this-work row contains Br, PDCBT and Cr labels differing from main composition and PEDOT:complex/MoO3/ITO/Au Methods.
issues.task_treatment: Main Methods define task fabrication route; record table disagreement, do not merge the stacks.

issues.title: S12 control panel temperatures
issues.source_issue: S12 caption labels both control panels c and d as 60 C, but the plotted panel c is labelled Control at 25 C and panel d Control at 60 C.
issues.task_treatment: Preserve caption-versus-panel disagreement. Methods independently define 25 C and 60 C routes; no hidden correction is made.

issues.title: Transport table cross-reference
issues.source_issue: S20 text points to Table S2, while transport fitting values are in Table S4.
issues.task_treatment: Cite actual labelled table; preserve incorrect cross-reference as a source issue.

issues.title: Crystallographic table cross-reference
issues.source_issue: S28 text points to Table S3; crystallographic table is S5.
issues.task_treatment: Cite actual S5; do not infer unseen measurements.

issues.title: Operando additive concentration conflict
issues.source_issue: Fabrication specifies 0.0078 M [Bcmim]Cl; operando Methods state 0.6 mol%, 0.78 mM.
issues.task_treatment: Preserve nominal target and both numeric claims; mock operando card is unresolved, not normalized to fabrication.

issues.title: pH concentration and panel membership conflict
issues.source_issue: Methods give 0.0075 mmol in 10.0 ml, arithmetically 0.00075 M; Table S3 says 0.0075 M and includes [Bcmim]BF4 omitted from the Methods list.
issues.task_treatment: Use six labelled comparison groups; flag BF4 preparation and concentration unresolved. No acidity target values awarded.

issues.title: Apparent kinetic units
issues.source_issue: S11 calls values apparent first-order rate constants but reports mM s^-1 units.
issues.task_treatment: Retain raw concentration/time records; do not label a fitted first-order constant in inverse-time units without a defined model.

issues.title: NMR control nominal percentages
issues.source_issue: Note 1 reports final LiCl 0.0065 M against 0.15 M MACl as 5 mol%; listed additions/final volumes are not fully self-consistent; TFA with [Bcmim] is mentioned in prose but not a numbered table row.
issues.task_treatment: Keep stated labels and numbers separate; include paired-TFA comparison as a reported-prose, underdetermined route, not a resolved recipe.

issues.title: External additive syntheses
issues.source_issue: [Bcmim]Cl, exchanged counterions and [C1SCNmim]Cl rely on references 33/34; no complete synthesis within retained paper/SI.
issues.task_treatment: Closed incoming-material provenance service with supplied symbolic raw lots. Synthesis completion is not credited; no guessed reaction route.

issues.title: Missing handling and apparatus interfaces
issues.source_issue: Transfer vessels, sample counts, grips, switches, carriers, cleaning details and almost all safety interlocks are not reported.
issues.task_treatment: Explicit authored robotic interfaces; Hooke supplies scenes. No claim of recovered human microtrajectory.

issues.title: Cleaning duration allocation
issues.source_issue: Sequential acetone/isopropanol/water ultrasonic cleaning is described with 15 min; allocation per solvent is not explicit.
issues.task_treatment: Use ordered three-stage proxy cycle; retain reported duration as unallocated metadata.

issues.title: Rapid-drying apparatus and coating details
issues.source_issue: Reference 35 supplies rapid-vacuum apparatus details; pressure, ramp, blade gap/speed and gas-pump/N2-knife settings are not provided here.
issues.task_treatment: Closed services expose only mock completion; unspecified numeric values stay null.

issues.title: Replicate and allocation counts
issues.source_issue: Scatter distributions are shown but independent-device/sample counts and cross-assay reuse lineage are not stated unambiguously.
issues.task_treatment: Default one distinct symbolic specimen per condition, with configurable authored replicate count. Never count scans/points as independent samples.

issues.title: Molar-percent denominator
issues.source_issue: Concentration-series prose and Methods do not use a universally explicit common denominator; crystallization microscopy explicitly references 1.0 M PbI2.
issues.task_treatment: Store mol% labels and absolute source concentrations independently; do not convert between them without a resolved card.

issues.title: Film-specific substrate preparation
issues.source_issue: Quartz, sapphire and FTO/c-TiO2/m-TiO2 optical substrates are named; the complete mesoporous-layer fabrication route is not provided.
issues.task_treatment: Separate raw-substrate-to-optical-film proxy with unresolved preparation metadata, not a claim that the device stack is equivalent.

issues.title: Phase snapshot acquisition geometry
issues.source_issue: Fig.4 gives 100 C snapshots at 2,5,10,15,20,30 s; in situ acquisition versus withdrawn sister coupons is not specified.
issues.task_treatment: Authored independent sister-film checkpoints; preserve this choice and never assert source chronology.

issues.title: Destructive measurement preparation
issues.source_issue: SEM cross-section cutting method, protective coatings, HIM region reuse and ToF depth calibration details are absent.
issues.task_treatment: Closed destructive-preparation proxy, independent sister specimens/regions by default; no pristine reuse.

issues.title: Calibration and derived quantities
issues.source_issue: PV irradiance, EQE integration spectrum, PLQY detailed reference procedure, TRMC K/FA/I/beta and absolute depth calibration are incompletely supplied.
issues.task_treatment: Records may remain raw or derived-unknown. External method refs 36/38 are dependencies, not silently imported procedures.

issues.title: Ageing allocation and environment details
issues.source_issue: Ten-day PPS storage temperature/conditions, film removal/reinsertion schedule, long-run cadence and full ISOS implementation details are not specified.
issues.task_treatment: Use explicitly authored sealed storage and service clock; predeclare same-specimen versus sister-specimen sampling, record gaps.

issues.title: Certification is external evidence
issues.source_issue: NPVM certificate is reported; shipping/selection chain and full external test procedure are absent.
issues.task_treatment: Authored mock dispatch/receipt task may assess chain of custody; never imply new certification or send anything externally.

issues.title: Unreported model solutions
issues.source_issue: S27 names NaPbI3 and comparison solutions but does not give a complete preparation route for each.
issues.task_treatment: Closed model-solution proxy with source-known identities, unresolved concentration/preparation; not a newly invented synthesis.

issues.title: Source interpretation is not direct observation
issues.source_issue: Depth distribution, grain-boundary location, acidity mechanism, defect passivation and nucleation mechanism include interpretations and different evidence strengths.
issues.task_treatment: Keep mock observations separate from optional interpretation; no reward for repeating causal claims as measured facts.

issues.title: NMR clock endpoints
issues.source_issue: Methods specify 96 time points at 15 min across 24 h; inclusive start/end convention is not explicit.
issues.task_treatment: Record timestamp grid from issued clock card; do not silently turn 96 acquisitions into 97.

issues.title: Crystal radiation identifier
issues.source_issue: Instrument name includes Cu, while S5 explicitly lists Mo K-alpha and wavelength 0.71073 A.
issues.task_treatment: Preserve instrument identifier and explicit radiation entry separately; no inferred source selection.

issues.title: Missing tolerances and service yield
issues.source_issue: No task-ready acceptance tolerances, processing yields, exact stock consumption or minimum film size for every test are given.
issues.task_treatment: Symbolic inventory conservation and observable mock success are authored. No quantitative chemical mass/yield claim.

issues.title: Shared fabrication route versus assay-specific preparation
issues.source_issue: Most film assay descriptions do not repeat a complete per-assay preparation route or every substrate/interface. Growth observation gives a different explicit PbI2 basis.
issues.task_treatment: Reusing a common fabrication prefix on compatible assay substrates is an authored connection. Source-specific named stacks and the growth precursor override it; unreported settings remain unknown.

resolution_policy: No silent source corrections. Mock-only services may use an explicitly unresolved-source card. Source-reproduction mode remains blocked. Authored values are labelled and never converted into reported facts.
